report_title: # P0040 ARC12 Uniform Frame-Size Fill Development-40 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive P0040 packet compares one bounded uniform-frame size-to-color compatibility family against P0039's immutable 3/40 same-cohort development baseline. P0039's filename-only all-training 20 ARC-AGI-1 plus 20 ARC-AGI-2 roster was committed at f1e9f94b33f899b9e9ec94436ea1951bdf5b7050 before its selected task grids were parsed, visualized, scored, or used for further operator design. Its retained failure reports then exposed a structural family: multiple monochrome hollow frames retain modal-background interior slots whose fill colors are a conflict-free function of visible interior dimensions. The P0040 operator rederives the unique modal background and every 4-connected monochrome rectangular perimeter from each current grid; it learns only a visible, conflict-free interior-height/interior-width-to-color table; it refuses tied backgrounds, non-background frame interiors, fewer than two frames or learned sizes, conflicting tables, and unseen test sizes. It does not branch on task ID, fixed colors, GT labels, cohort metadata, historical decomposition, or held-out test output. The controller receives only each task's visible demonstrations and test input before committing a complete grid. The new relation and concise future diagram label are frozen at c3842b7d28fb2829b79ec815a99b1bc39912a189 before this packet runs. P0040 is intentionally same-cohort development evidence, not fresh transfer or an ARC-AGI-1/ARC-AGI-2 solver claim.
